title: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: cDNA Synthesis
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform library prep steps on 8-48 input total RNA samples according to the attached NEB user guide. This is part-2 of a six part process (first strand and second strand cDNA synthesis). Reagents are combined into two mixtures (mix1 is composed of water + first strand enzyme mix, mix2 is composed of second strand reaction buffer + second strand enzyme mix + water) to reduce the number of transfer steps. A user-specified parameter is available to specify the number of samples in the current run. ---
The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The OT-2 will pause for an off-deck incubation.

steps.title: Prepare reagent mixtures
steps.instruction: Create two master mixes: mix1 = water plus first‑strand enzyme mix; mix2 = second‑strand reaction buffer plus second‑strand enzyme mix plus water. Use the multi‑channel P20 and P300 pipettes and set the user‑specified parameter for the number of samples (8–48).

substeps.instruction: Combine water with first‑strand enzyme mix to make mix1.
Combine second‑strand reaction buffer, second‑strand enzyme mix, and water to make mix2.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature modules
steps.instruction: Set the OT‑2 temperature modules to 4 °C using the OT app before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes on deck
steps.instruction: Confirm that all reagents (mix1, mix2, and any other required solutions) are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume as indicated by the protocol alert.

steps.title: Add mix1 to RNA samples
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, dispense 10 µL of mix1 into each fragmented, primed poly(A) RNA sample and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate first‑strand reaction off‑deck
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2 and place the plate off‑deck for the first‑strand incubation as directed by the protocol.

steps.title: Add mix2 to first‑strand reaction
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense 60 µL of mix2 into each well containing the first‑strand reaction and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate second‑strand reaction off‑deck
steps.instruction: After adding mix2, the OT‑2 notifies you to proceed with the off‑deck incubation for the second‑strand synthesis.
